column1: # Per-artifact provenance for the machine-generated fingerprint captures.
# Tab-separated: path, sha256, generator, source, invocation.
# Checked by scripts/check_fixture_manifest.sh: every entry's digest must match the committed
# bytes, and every generated-looking artifact (exporter header, or any *.hex here) must have an
# entry. Regeneration provenance itself is enforced end-to-end by
# scripts/regenerate-fingerprint-fixtures.sh; seeds and lineage are in PROVENANCE.md.
